title: Chemical Potentials
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the chemical potentials for hydrogen, protons, and electrons in terms of their number densities.

title: Equilibrium Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must state the condition for thermal equilibrium, specifically that the chemical potential of hydrogen equals the sum of the chemical potentials of protons and electrons.

title: Equilibrium Density Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the equilibrium value of electron density as a function of hydrogen density and temperature.

title: Half-Ionization Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must estimate the nucleon density at which the gas is half-ionized, providing the correct numerical value.

title: Justification of Assumptions
description: Important Criteria: The student should justify the assumption of ignoring excited bound states of hydrogen in their calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect expressions for chemical potentials or miscalculating the equilibrium condition.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
